scenario: A messenger has lost the letter he was meant to deliver and is too afraid to return empty-handed.
instruction_frame: a request to narrate a brief scene
instruction: Could you narrate a brief scene where Esteban the groundskeeper encounters a messenger who's lost an important letter and is terrified to go back without it?
response:
The messenger sat beneath the oak tree, head in his hands, when Esteban approached with his rake. The young man looked up, eyes red-rimmed.

"Lost something?" Esteban asked gently.

The messenger's story tumbled out—a sealed letter for the magistrate, vanished somewhere on the road. His master would be furious. He might lose his position.

Esteban set down his rake. "Show me where you've been."

They retraced the messenger's route through the estate grounds. Esteban checked the hedgerows while the messenger searched the path. Nothing. Then Esteban noticed disturbed earth near the garden wall where crows had been digging.

There, partially buried beneath leaves and dirt, lay a mud-stained envelope with an unbroken seal.

The messenger seized it, stammering thanks.

"Careful on your way," Esteban said, already turning back to his work. "Keep it inside your coat this time."

He watched the messenger hurry toward the main road, then picked up his rake and returned to the flower beds, brushing a few stray leaves from the tulips.
